meta.name: resolving-merge-conflicts
meta.description: Use when you need to resolve an in-progress git merge/rebase conflict.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解决 Git 合并或变基中的代码冲突
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在合并分支时遇到冲突需要解决
copy.tagline_en: Resolve code conflicts during Git merge or rebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you encounter conflicts while merging branches

howto.what: Claude 会帮你分析合并冲突的当前状态，查找冲突来源，逐块解决冲突，运行自动化检查，最后完成合并或变基。
howto.when: 当你正在进行 git 合并或变基操作，并且遇到冲突时触发。

say.text: 帮我解决这个合并冲突
say.note: Claude 会分析冲突文件并给出解决方案。

say.text: 查看当前合并状态并解决冲突
say.note: Claude 会检查 git 历史和冲突文件。

say.text: 运行自动化检查并完成合并
say.note: Claude 会运行类型检查、测试和格式化。

howto.what_en: Claude will analyze the current state of the merge conflict, find the sources of each conflict, resolve each hunk, run automated checks, and finish the merge or rebase.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are in the middle of a git merge or rebase and encounter conflicts.

say_en.text: Help me resolve this merge conflict
say_en.note: Claude will analyze conflicting files and propose solutions.

say_en.text: Show current merge status and resolve conflicts
say_en.note: Claude will check git history and conflicting files.

say_en.text: Run automated checks and finish the merge
say_en.note: Claude will run typecheck, tests, and formatting.
